name: Deborah Secco
bio: Deborah Fialho Secco (Rio de Janeiro, November 26, 1979) is a Brazilian actress. She became known in 1994 as one of the protagonists of the teen series Confessões de Adolescente (1994). On television, she played successful characters such as Íris in Laços de Família (2000), Darlene in Celebridade (2003), Sol in América (2005), Natalie Lamour in Insensato Coração (2011), Karola in Segundo Sol (2018)and Alexia Máximo in Salve-se Quem Puder (2020). In cinema, she stood out as Moema in Caramuru - The Invention of Brazil (2001), Judite in Boa Sorte (2014) and the title character in Bruna Surfistinha (2011).
place: Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
